title: inula ciliaris
intro: Inula ciliaris, commonly known as Golden Samos or Elephant's Foot, is a perennial plant in the daisy family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Inula ciliaris include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and hepatoprotective effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues, support immune function, and protect the liver from damage. The bioactive constituents of Inula ciliaris include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential to treat various health conditions.
